{{Top|leg}}
A '''disguise kit''' was a personal [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] that allowed the user to change their appearance. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Finn Varatha]] utilized a disguise kit, often posing as someone close to her target in order to capture them.<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>
